title: Are Russian Barrels Getting Out Of Favor
section_path: Are Russian Barrels Getting Out Of Favor
section_path_text: Are Russian Barrels Getting Out Of Favor
summary:
Demand for Russian crude is cooling as sanctions tighten
When Russia invaded Ukraine a little more than two years ago, the reaction from many Western companies and governments was swift. They slapped a multitude of sanctions on the Kremlin regime and vowed to stop importing Russian crude oil and refined products. The G7 sanctions initiated a massive reshuffling of crude oil trade flows as Russia was forced to look for alternative customers for their oil.
